fees.description: Other fees may apply. Information regarding fees is set out on our fees page powershop.com.au/fees
Reconnection fees may apply to re-energise a property and remove locks. The fee will be passed on from your distributor and may vary.
Fees may apply for a move in read. The fee will be passed on from your distributor and may vary.
Fees may apply for a move out read. The fee will be passed on from your distributor and may vary.

gasContract.terms: A credit card or direct debit payment method is required as part of the sign up process. Other payment methods are available. You can change your payment method by contacting Powershop on 1800 462 668. For further information in relation to this offer, see our terms and conditions at: powershop.com.au/terms-and-conditions

discounts.description: $200 sign up credit is available to residential customers who have not held a gas market contract with Powershop for the premises within the previous 12 months, and is applied 90 days after your Powershop online account has become active. We will send you an email letting you know when you’re officially a customer.

gasContract.variation: We may vary your prices at any time. If we vary your prices we'll give you advance notice, usually by email.

eligibility.information: To be eligible to receive the sign-up credit for this plan, you must be a residential customer who has not held a gas market contract with Powershop for the premises within the previous 12 months. Plan only available via direct retailer sign-up. For full terms, see powershop.com.au/customer-terms-and-conditions/energy-offers-terms-and-conditions

gasContract.onExpiryDescription: This is an ongoing contract (until you or we end it) with no exit fees.
